description: Northern Powergrid Load Indices is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This dataset comprises of Northern Powergrid's Load Index submission, giving the maximum demand for each of our EHV sites. It also provides the Firm Capacity of the site, and what the limiting factor in determining that capacity is. Finally it contains details on work being done at sites to increase capacity. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), Demand, Network Capacity and Utilisation, Network Reinforcement and Interventions. The portal shows 2024-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
